justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/PDF417Common.java, PDF417Reader.java, PDF417Writer.java, and PDF417ResultMetadata.java. The exact package contains only 4 production classes totaling 950 LOC (463 + 141 + 175 + 171). Their roles are narrow and separated: PDF417Writer is an encode façade that delegates to com.google.zxing.pdf417.encoder.*, PDF417Reader is a decode façade that delegates to com.google.zxing.pdf417.decoder.* and com.google.zxing.pdf417.detector.*, PDF417ResultMetadata is a simple data holder, and PDF417Common is a constants/utility class. This looks like a small façade package around specialized subpackages, not an excessively large or responsibility-concentrating god component.
